title: Notify the use of pesticides near sensitive places
summary: Learn the requirements and steps for notifying the use of pesticides near sensitive places.
intro:
Pest management technicians must provide at least 5 working days' notice to the person responsible for a sensitive place, if you'll be spraying pesticides, or injecting liquid pesticides into the ground, within 20 metres of that sensitive place.

Check the Pest management technicians' fact sheet – PDF for details or an example notice.
who_can_apply: Pest management technicians who plan to spray or inject liquid pesticides near a sensitive place.
what_you_need: At least 5 working days' notice to the person responsible for the sensitive place.
The following information to provide to the neighbouring sensitive place: (Specific details not listed in the provided text)
The ability to lodge the notice by email, fax, post, or in person.
A method to record pesticide application details within 24 hours and keep a paper copy for 3 years.

how_to_steps.text: Download a notice template or draw up your notice.
Lodge your notice by email, fax, post, or in person, with the person in charge of the affected sensitive place (such as the school principal, director or manager).
You must record details of the pesticide application within 24 hours of using it and keep a paper copy of this record for 3 years.

contact: If you have questions, you can email the NSW Environment Protection Authority or call the Environment Line on 131 555.

more_info.text: Fines apply if you're unable to show evidence that you provided the required notification.
You should have copies of the safety data sheet (SDS) in case someone requests them.

faqs.q: How far away must a sensitive place be from pesticide application?
faqs.a: The notice must be provided if you are spraying or injecting liquid pesticides within 20 metres of the sensitive place.

faqs.q: How much notice is required before applying pesticides?
faqs.a: Pest management technicians must provide at least 5 working days' notice to the person responsible for the sensitive place.

faqs.q: What must I do after using pesticides?
faqs.a: You must record details of the pesticide application within 24 hours of using it and keep a paper copy of this record for 3 years.
